name: mindpalace
description: Layered memory supersystem (v3) — self/events/entities/knowledge layers behind one tool surface. Mutually exclusive with the Memory plugin: enable one, not both. Import copies from the classic system; old data is never touched.
author: sapphire

settings.label: Librarian (ALPHA)
settings.help: Master switch for the librarian: single-purpose passes that date, link, dedup, and sort memories. Off = the core memory system runs alone. Configure passes, schedules, and maintenance in Mind → Admin. Alpha — testing cohort only.

confirm.title: Enable the Librarian — Alpha Feature
warnings: Alpha testing — not ready for production use
The AI reviews and reorganizes its own memories: dating, linking, merging, splitting, promoting, and retiring entries
Nothing is ever hard-deleted — retired memories stay visible in the Memories view and restore with one click
Mind → Admin can undo librarian retirements in bulk

settings.label: Context limit (tokens)
settings.help: Context window for librarian sessions — the night chat grows across passes and the normal chat default trims it far too early. 131072 (128K) suits most models; raise to 262144 only if the librarian model supports it.

settings.label: Memories per pass
settings.help: How many unprocessed memories one librarian pass takes on. The rest wait for the next pass.

settings.label: Memories per message
settings.help: How many memories are presented per chat message during a pass. Smaller = more careful, more tokens.

settings.label: Max passes per day (per kind)
settings.help: Safety cap per scope and pass kind across all triggers (button, tool, schedule).

settings.label: Duplicate threshold
settings.help: Similarity (0.5-0.99) two memories must measure before merge_memories will fold them — enforced in code, not prompt. Higher = only near-identical entries merge.

settings.label: Allow rewrite on merge
settings.help: Let merge_memories write a distilled replacement text. Off (default): the longest original survives verbatim — the similarity gate proves two entries are duplicates, but nothing validates a rewrite, so a bad model could fabricate the surviving text.

settings.label: Drain: batches per chat
settings.help: Run ALL groups this many batches into one rolling chat before resetting — accumulated context helps judgment passes (sort) calibrate; 1 = fresh chat every batch.

settings.label: Fresh chat per session
settings.help: Each librarian session gets its own chat (librarian-YYYYMMDD-HHMM): a per-session audit trail that keeps old pass transcripts out of new passes' context. Off: everything lands in the single shared 'librarian' chat.

settings.label: Model override
settings.help: Model for librarian passes (empty = the app's normal selection). Passes read raw memory in bulk — a local model here is both a cost and a privacy lever, while a cloud model means memory text leaves the machine on every pass (key-gated private memories are excluded from tending and never ride). The dates pass wants a 9B-class model or better; below that, the built-in date resolver alone is more accurate.

settings.label: Nightly tending schedule
settings.help: Run the nightly round: an importance decay tick (when Importance is enabled), then librarian passes over every scope that opted in on its Self page (Resident strip — per-scope pass pills, default off). Manual runs are unaffected.

settings.label: Nightly time
settings.help: Local time for the nightly run (24h HH:MM).

settings.label: Standing note (all passes)
settings.placeholder: One instruction injected into every pass, every scope
settings.help: Injected verbatim into EVERY librarian pass of every scope, right after the message header, as '— Standing note from your user —'. The cross-cutting lever: per-pass wording lives in each pass card's gear (charter modal); this is for the thing you want said everywhere. Empty = absent.

settings.label: Importance (ALPHA)
settings.help: Master switch for the importance system: librarian ratings, spider pricing by salience, nightly decay, and recall boost. Off = flat, neutral memory — no lurking variables. Alpha — testing cohort only.

confirm.title: Enable Importance — Alpha Feature
warnings: Alpha testing — not ready for production use
Memories gain salience ratings that shape which connections surface in search
With the nightly schedule on, ratings drift down over time (decay) and direct recalls nudge them up
Memory content is never changed or deleted — Mind → Admin resets all ratings in one click

settings.label: Importance: decay per night
settings.help: Nightly drift toward the floor (0.1) for rated, non-favorite memories below the 0.9 core band. Unrated memories never move. 0 disables decay. Applies only while Importance is enabled.

settings.label: Importance: boost per recall
settings.help: Bump when a rated memory comes back as a direct search hit — once per memory per day, ceiling 0.85 (recall alone never mints core status). Unrated memories never move. 0 disables. Applies only while Importance is enabled.

settings.label: Wake: important memories per item
settings.help: read_self(depth) pulls this many memories for EACH value, project, and relationship on the self sheet (the Important Memories wake section, deduped against recent memories). Depth 1 caps at 3 per item; this sets the depth-2 ceiling (max 10). 0 turns the section off.

settings.label: Person card size (chars)
settings.help: Max characters of a person's card (description + Background/Interests/Voice/Likes/Dislikes fields) when it renders to the AI — on a direct name search, and card-first in read_self's important-people groups. Clamped 200-4000. Sparse cards arrive whole; rich ones get trimmed to fit.

settings.label: Spider: connections budget at depth 1 (tokens)
settings.help: Size cap for the 'Connected memories' block at depth 1, on top of the direct results (typically ~2K) — about 4K total.

settings.label: Spider: connections budget at depth 2 (tokens)
settings.help: Size cap for the 'Connected memories' block at depth 2 — about 8K total with a typical base return. Depth 3+ clamps to 2.

settings.label: Knowledge: chunks per document in mixed search
settings.help: A big document (a whole book) is hundreds of sub-chunks — in an all-layer search, each knowledge document surfaces at most this many (1-10). search_memory with layer='knowledge' ignores the cap for deep dives.

schedule.name: Librarian nightly
schedule.description: Nightly mind tending: importance decay tick (when Importance is enabled), then librarian passes over the configured scopes (when Librarian is enabled).
